Keep ordinary mission, diplomatic mission, scouting mission and religious purpose as tasks/purposes.

source_inventory.en: St. Hadwyn's Mission
St. Hadwyn's Perpetual Mission
St. Eadric's Mission
Mission Well
St. Eadric's Perpetual Mission

I was instructed by the Hierophant Shrine to steal three items in order to prove my worth to the Travelers. The items are: the Grilricas Medallion, which belongs to a noble stuck in the Didenhil Inn, the Pall of St. Eadric, resting in a sarcophagus in the nearby Almain Mission, and a pair of daggers, called Draug's Toothpicks, owned by Gunnar Frode of the Vorm Lodge, in the Sidhe.
Warsworn here means you're picked for the hardest, most dangerous missions.
Mitharu does not dwell behind the Mission's walls. No. She is in every rock and every tree, every bud and every storm. She is with all of us!
Are you sure you want me to conduct a spying mission?
I will be away for as long as it takes to complete my mission.
Behold our unassuming Mission. Pure and simple as the very first waters!
Those fools in that mission on the hill are wasting their days. Creatures of such power do not worship gods. They are gods.
Back to the mission.
I find them so interesting, from their vestments to their odd habits and demeanors. Just yesterday I saw a monk from the Almain mission sneaking through the underbrush.

In this confession I shall tell of how my master was brought nearly to his death.
Arkes failed Ethene in our mission to bring her servants to a devout state
That would be worthy of her power and wisdom.
At my behest, he sought the Hyperian forced to the sky, and earn our recognition.
The ensuing eruption of Ethene’s wrath killed many, and nearly took dear Arkes.
St. Odwig's Mission
St. Eadric's Mission
Help me to expose the Mission for what it truly is: a prison of ideas in which they hope to keep us locked away forever. But I tell you, your mind must not be caged!

Brother Delf, of St. Odwig's Mission, has asked me to kill the bandit captain, Red Idward, who, in turn, wants to kill Delf for deserting. Before I can act, I must speak with Delf's fellow deserters about their Red Legion daggers. Ugnar is in Gorhart Village, and Itran is east in Haxhi.
A lovely mission, far to the south, in the depths of the Sidhe. It's been many years since I've been there, I'm afraid.
You just brought all your gear and set out on some secret mission. You didn't even leave anything in your room in the tower. Honest!
I ‒ it is much to ask, but none in our camp have been able to stand against him. You must answer his challenge. Fight him again, kill him, for the sake of our mission!
Well, Brother Fallon should have it. But then, he should have been here by now. Go up into Glendara Wood, toward the mission. See what you can find.
You must think me a fool. And Father Dynwel.... Come. Let's return to the Mission. I must ask forgiveness of so many.
Octienne's journal shows that Ventrinio's assistant died during an important mission into the heart of Alabastra.
The Mission
Now that I've fulfilled my mission, what else is there? Gallows End raised me, and the island will see me to sleep.

Avery,

I came to Gorhart to look after your kin. Rikka is as wonderful as you described. Yet she is a shadow.

She misses you, my friend. As do we all. I will watch over her since you cannot. And I will visit you often. This war be damned.

Who would have guessed I would come to a mission, and trade a prison for a cloister? If only we had both escaped. Alas, the bars were too strong, the Tuatha too cruel.

Your brother in arms,
Mason
St. Odwig's Mission
This mission was established twenty years ago. The gardens and fauna pens were Father Etair's idea. He marveled at Mitharu's gifts, the magic in the world around us.
Go on a diplomatic mission.
What's my first mission?

Now that I've entered the St. Eadric's Mission well I should begin a search for the crystals that Father Etair and Brother Wulf found during their excavation. Whatever the crystals are, they are important to the Maid's plans.
In the margins of this weathered old journal are the daily devotionals and musings of Father Etair, spiritual leader of St. Eadric's Perpetual Mission in Haxhi.
The Mission
Once you've given me my mission, I will depart immediately to deliver whatever message or gesture you see fit.
That's why he had to be stopped. And why we need to talk about our mission.
Now that I'm free again, it's vital that we continue with my mission. Otherwise, Mithros... and Amalur... will be in great danger.
The brothers of St. Odwig's Perpetual Mission keep the valuable tome in their reliquary, but no one outside the Order is allowed a glimpse.
The Mission
It filled the hunger I was hoping to sate with wine, women, anything and everything. This mission gives my life meaning.
You don't know? It is less a mission than a fortress of deception, a citadel of lies. It throws its menacing shadow over all of Gorhart.
Descend the Mission well
St. Odwig's Mission
Father Etair watches over a small Almain mission in the southeast. St. Eadric's. You will know it by the ruins on the hill.
You're right. The show must go on. Visit the shrine of the Hierophant, and you shall receive portents of your mission.
What kind of diplomatic mission would you like me to conduct with them?

Brother Fallon left St. Hadwyn's Undying Mission over a day ago to bring medical supplies to Didenhil. Brother Udo has asked me to look for him, and, if the worst has happened, return with Fallon's prayer beads.
I took up a collection around the Mission. I lied and said it was for charity, but you understand.... The others can never know. Thank you.

This locked bookshelf houses the collection of Brother Til, the late Scripture Master of St. Odwig's Perpetual Mission. From the looks of the titles on the remaining books, Til's literary interests tended toward the lewd and lascivious. You may retrieve all of the missing volumes and return them to Til's Collection for a reward.
Welcome back. If you wish to enter the Mission then you will need to serve its needs, and Brother Egan is still missing.
Oh, yes. I trust no one else in Gale Crossing with such a sensitive mission.
First, there is a noble, Ealfwig Grilricas, staying in Didenhil. Steal his medallion. Then, in the nearby mission, claim the pall of the dead Saint Eadric's.
St. Odwig's Mission
St. Eadric's Mission
Must we return to the Mission? I crave adventure, magic, power!
I only just enlisted. Did a mission with old Ost Ordura.
King Wencen has an important mission for me, and I must speak to him to learn the details. He should be in the House of Ballads Court of Enchantments.
When I saw you could change Fate, I knew you were our only choice. So I helped you continue your mission to stop Tirnoch - even if you had forgotten it.
Most importantly, he was once an ally of the master weaponsmith, Skald Atlas. She will be crucial to your mission.
I expect Brother Wulf is working diligently, and when he returns I will accompany him on another expedition down into the mission well.
Brother Fallon... dead, then? A shame. He should never have left the Mission.
Complete Ost's mission
Irion and Maire once tolerated those critical of the Hierophant, but no longer. Say one bad thing now, and, you're sent on a mission you don't return from.
This corpse contains a Mission Brief from Shieldring Keep: Warsworn Ledger
When I saw you could change Fate, I knew you were our only choice. So I helped you continue your mission to stop Tirnoch - even if you had forgotten it.
Things are as dire as I said, mortal. Grim Onwig has been caught on a mission, and needs assistance.
The Mission
Now we have a chance to finally complete our mission. Let's put an end to Gadflow, before his bargain frees Tirnoch on the world.
St. Odwig's Mission
Go up the road through Glendara Wood that leads to the mission. Bring the Plagueshield yourself, if you must.
The real mission goes to General Tilera and yourself. My place is with my brothers and sisters, on the ground and against the enemy.
St. Odwig's Mission
St. Hadwyn's Perpetual Mission

The shrine is silent, but you are reminded of the items the Hierophant asked you to steal: the medallion of Ealfwig Grilricas, in Didenhil, the burial pall of St. Eadric, found in St. Eadric's Perpetual Mission, and Draug's Toothpicks ‒ a pair of daggers that are currently in the posession of Gunnar Frode, in the Sidhe.
Father Dynwel says I have a promising future here at the mission. My dish-washing is inspired. His words.
He'll be missed sorely, here and up at the mission. May Mitharu keep him.
Irion once tolerated those that besmirched the Hierophant, but no longer. If you say one bad thing, you're sent on a mission you don't return from.
I was hoping to sneak into Dark Harbor and secure The Requiem. Once my mission is finished I'll need a way to get back off this cursed island.
Complete Ost's mission
Welcome to the mission.
You're leading this mission now. You might want to introduce yourself.
I have been with the mission since its founding ‒ these boys are like my sons. I live my life as an example of Mitharu's wishes for our kind.
St. Odwig's Mission
Your mission is twice-damned already. The Primos is a recluse.
I've returned Brother Egan to his family at St. Odwig's Perpetual Mission in Gorhart. He should be fine, with time...
What kind of diplomatic mission would you like me to conduct with the Dverga in Emberdeep?
That's why he had to be stopped. And why we need to talk about our mission.
Take the Mission Brief
St. Odwig's Mission
Regrettably, my spy mission was discovered and, thus, relations have suffered.
My, my. Is Star Camp being visited by a goddess? Are they all as beautiful as you? Maybe I should slap on a habit and join the Mission down the road.
The mission is quiet. I like that.
To think, I may have led you astray, sent you on a dangerous mission to recover a valuable artifact. For my sake, I hope I'm wrong.
I only just enlisted. Did a mission with old Ost Ordura.
Get your next mission
The old Fateweaver? He's not in the city. He's been sent elsewhere on a mission.
Red Idward is dead, and now I should return to Brother Delf and give him the news. He should be at St. Odwig's Mission in western Odarath.
What brings you to our humble Mission? You have heard of our remarkable shards and gems, perhaps? Are you a follower of Mitharu, here to worship?
St. Odwig's Mission
I've killed someone who could have helped me bring Brother Egan back to St. Odwig's Perpetual Mission. Now he will never get home.
I have accompanied these noble Alfar in peace, and I would make use of you in my mission, if you are willing.
I've been wrongfully imprisoned. I'm one of them brothers from the mission. I swear on... on... what's that god's name again?

Summer, Day 6, Daybreak

Nothing today. My journey is young and the forest remains fairly hospitable to outsiders. Ignoring the warnings was a wise decision. There are no rivals. The search for Amman's keys belongs to me, and me alone. It is only a matter of time. The statues of Amman litter the forest, taunting me. If I can just secure the keys, I will be able to open them and partake of their treasures. Soon.

Summer, Day 13, Dusk

Odarath is as beautiful as I have always heard, especially the perilous lands north of St. Odwig's Perpetual Mission. I was almost struck down by a sprite! That is until a brave villager from Gorhart arrived on the scene to act as my savior. He introduced himself as Ugnar Odgray. Such an odd name, it could only belong to a Varani.

Summer, Day 67, Daybreak

I visited the House of Ballads grounds today! All of my adult life has been spent learning about these legendary figures, so even a slight glimpse was worth the trip. I am beginning to believe that one of Amman's keys lies behind its high walls. If my scholarly work has been done correctly, the location of the keys will soon be known to me.

Summer, Day 83, Dusk

I have done it! At long last, after years searching in the annals of Adessa and scouring the fae lands, I have secured one of the five fabled keys of Amman!

Now only if I could find the other four....

I've met a gnome named Ariel Perien in Drowned Forest. She is on a mission to retrieve an artifact from Bonnlach, but her hired porter ‒ Deod Dungaras ‒ has been carried off by murghan. She has hired me to find him and retrieve her pack.
I don't trust the brothers of St. Odwig's. Why should I? They stay holed up in that mission like rats.
Don't tell anyone, but I once caught Rikka Egest embracing one of the monks from the mission. Quite scandalous.

Thursday

The strange crystal sits atop my desk. I cannot take my eyes from it. It is not out of adoration, or even fascination, but out of a tense, foreboding dread that never escapes me, not even as I lay in my bunk at night hoping that I have not doomed my young charges by bringing this cursed thing up from the underground.

Perhaps the most troubling development is how the crystal affects young Brother Wulf. This person sitting across the chamber from me is no longer my bright, friendly apprentice, but a heavy-eyed fanatic. The strange allure of the crystal has touched him on some spiritual level. He has not been to chapel in days. He has not bathed or eaten. He does not respond to his name, and when does take notice of the others around him, he does so with a gruff sneer. I grieve for him as one mourns the deceased. All day long he stares at the crystal, or plays to it with his whistle, making the swirling red surface flash. My prayers do nothing.

All of my research, all of my training, none of it has provided the answers I seek. What is this strange substance and from where does it derive its magic? What created it and how did it come to be beneath our mission? Better yet, how I can I get dispose of it without hurting my dear friend? So many questions, but no answers come.

Perhaps tomorrow Mitharu will provide. He has yet to disappoint me.
The Mission Brief on that corpse said it was from Shieldring Keep. I should go there and let them know I have completed the mission.
Scouting Mission
Here we are, Deireadh. I am lucky enough ‒ my mission is complete. The Sorrows have already begun to awaken, mortal. Soon they will flood your world.

In this confession I shall tell of how my master was brought nearly to his death.
Arkes failed Ethene in our mission to bring her servants to a devout state
That would be worthy of her power and wisdom.
At my behest, he sought the Hyperian forced to the sky, and earn our recognition.
The ensuing eruption of Ethene’s wrath killed many, and nearly took dear Arkes.
What kind of diplomatic mission would you like me to conduct with them?
Ah, a follower of the great Order of the World. You are of course welcome to our humble mission, and all of Mitharu's homes.
Bisarane has asked me to join him in the audience chamber of the House of Sorrows. There we will discuss my first mission to help save the House from the Tuatha's attacks.
Why, those are Brother Fallon's prayer beads, aren't they? They'll want those at the mission, I imagine.
St. Odwig's Mission
We should not discuss your next mission here. Let us return to the House of Sorrows, and converse in the audience chamber.
The brothers of St. Odwig's are an odd sort, scurrying back and forth across the mission like squirrels gathering nuts. I wonder what goes on behind those closed doors.
Just give me my mission.
Ah, a follower of the great Order of the World. You are of course welcome to our humble mission, and all of Mitharu's homes.

I have stolen the Ordination Tome from the reliquary at St. Odwig's Perpetual Mission. I should deliver it to Sister Zelda in Gorhart Village, so she will be able to prove that women can be members of the Order of Mitharu.

I don't know if you'll ever find this, but I wanted to write it anyway. Captain Canwen has ordered us to hold the line. But the bolgan and Tuatha are many. I do not expect to live through the night. Please, know that I cared for you, even though we only ever acted as friends. Such feelings can only be adoration, Hillared my sweet. I hope your mission home to Castle Gastyr finds luck. Perhaps we will meet again in another life. Love, Piers
What kind of diplomatic mission would you like me to conduct with the Ljosalfar in Hrenloc?
Explore the mission and introduce yourself to the brothers. They will be very pleased to meet the hero who brought back our beloved Egan.

I hid the stash where we used to play as kids. No one knew those ruins like us, did they?

Avoid the mission. Not safe anymore. Just get the gold, then get out. If the trolls give you a scare, just climb the nearest trees. They can't climb, right?

See you on the Long Road.

T

source_inventory.en: I've succeeded in my mission to rid Amalur of Telogrus. It's time to return to the Order of Fateweavers in Rathir. They wait for me in the Orbocant.
St. Odwig's Mission
I have helped Sister Zelda acquire the proof she needs to become a monk in the Order of Mitharu. Her future is now with the brothers in St. Odwig's Mission.

Back where it all began, aren’t we? Perhaps you never figured it out – or do not remember – but from this very hideout on Dannestar, I facilitated your infiltration mission into Alabastra.

How times have changed. How you have changed! And, if I am being honest – for the better. I’d never have guessed you’d be the one to save the world in the end! And now you saved me, too...

Actually you saved me from the embarrassment of having forgotten my armor in my den. Yes, yes, I know it’s nothing important or secret but I really, REALLY did not want it in the hands of those White Palm scum. You are the only one I trust to handle this delicate piece with the right amount of decency. And I know you always liked my gear... for reasons.

So, as a kind of intimate reward, just keep it as a memento of me and the olden times. Do what you fancy. It’s yours now.

Maybe... until we meet again somewhere... sometime. That would be nice.

Yours, Alyn Shir.
Why, aren't those Brother Fallon's prayer beads? You should bring those up to St. Hadwyn's Mission. It's only right.
There is so much talk of gods and faith in Idylla. But out here, I feel as though it is only me on this mission.
I wanted the mission's crystals, but the mortal and his boy would not cooperate. But, I always find a way to get what I desire. Don't we all?

By Brother Gamian of St. Hadwyn's Undying Mission

I ask you to consider what a gem truly is. Order and clarity, exemplified. A conduit of might and light. What then is a shard? It can become a gem, but as yet, it is neither ordered, nor clear, nor powerful.

Think now how much mortal-kind are like unto gems and shards! Though we enter this world rough-hewn and of little worth, we may work hard, we may refine ourselves until we become shining conduits of Mitharu's Light.

A lazy man or a woman of wayward habits is a thing of little force in the world. At best, they accomplish nothing; at worst, they do great harm. Surely Mitharu loves them not. But those who are dilligent, industrious, and clear of focus. It is they who achieve great things, bring honor and purity to the world. They are truly champions of the god of order.

Consider this, as well: how few of us are are perfect gems ‒ by which I mean, saints ‒ and yet, imperfect as we are, by way of the sage's craft, we make perfect gems from shards. Truly this is Mitharu's gift to we frail shards. And truly the practice of sagecraft is an excellent meditation on all these lessons.
You can stay here as long as you like. You're welcome to whatever supplies you can scrounge up around the mission. Mitharu will provide for us.
You should join me here at the mission. You're like me, curious about the mysteries of the outside world.
The trade mission was a success.
At each mission ‒ Odwig's, Eadric's, and our own, there is a special shrine to Mitharu.
Brother Nuk, of St. Odwig's Mission.
You must go to Ohn's Stand, in Lorca-Rane. That was where Grim's mission had taken him. But be warned. Something is not right about this...
What kind of diplomatic mission would you like me to conduct with them?
That's your mission.
It is difficult to envision the Court and its mission without Wencen; but we will carry on, as does the Telling. It is our duty as knights of the Summer Court.
What's my next mission?
At each mission ‒ Odwig's, Eadric's, and our own, there is a special shrine to Mitharu.
But no longer. I failed my mission... and in my failure, I forgot myself. All is well. For Denric was but a humble monk while here I am a king!
St. Eadric's Mission
You must steal three objects: a medallion from Didenhil, a pall from St. Eadric's Mission, and some daggers from the Sidhe.

Avery,

Mitharu has made it known to me. I must leave St. Odwig's Mission, and Odarath. You see, I am in love, and that love is forbidden. Not only does my Order frown upon such earthly concerns, but such an act would dishonor you, as well. "Why?" you may ask. I cannot love this woman because it is Rikka. It is your wife.

So I am taking leave of the mission, abandoning my post as Alms Master. Perhaps one day I will return, but not in disgrace. I cannot do that to you, or to Rikka, or to my master, Mitharu.

Farewell, my friend and brother. Rest in good peace. Soft peace. Peace without further pain.

Your brother in arms forever,
Mason
"Our" mission? You betrayed me!

Bisarane has informed me that a coup occurred while I was performing my last mission. He wants me to follow those who deserted him to the Fallen Hall and help them against the Tuatha ambush that is likely waiting for them there.
Are we not lied to enough? We are at war! We scrabble for every supper! We live in fear of one another! Shouldn't the Mission unite us?
I'd rather we not speak. I'm on a mission, and anyone not helping me is a hindrance.
I wish the brothers of the mission could offer the rest of us in town some solace. They seem completely ignorant of our troubles.
I have completed my mission and killed the notorious pirate Dead Kel. The people of Gallows End must find a new way of life, one without their "god," the great tree known as Akara the Exile.
Do not stray too far from the Court of Enchantments, Sagrell. For Hallam has requested you for this mission. And Hallam does not make demands lightly.

Hallam the White believes that an alchemist and Mitharu father named Etair may have insight into how the Maid of Windemere is changing the great Fae songs. Etair lives in St. Eadric's Perpetual Mission in the Sidhe, to the southeast.
Have you come to protest the mission as well? The news has spread to every village. It's on every tongue. We are so close!
I cannot deceive you: this will be a suicide mission, but we've come too far to turn back now.
Aethen Engar has dispatched me on my next mission. I must travel to Emaire in the Cradle of Summer and speak with Anker Edmure, to discern the meaning of his message "Shardfall has come alive".
Very well. Go the Hierophant Shrine, and pray. There you will receive portents of the next mission from our grand leader.
Where is the order that Mitharu has given us? I see no order in obstructing the truth. That is chaos! That is what the mission fears!
St. Odwig's Perpetual Mission
Those are Brother Fallon's prayer beads you have there. You should bring them to the mission when you are able.

Brother Delf, of St. Odwig's Mission, has asked me to help him avoid retaliation from the leader of the Red Legion, Red Idward. I've agreed to recover ceremonial Red Legion daggers from former members Ugnar Odgray, of Gorhart Village, and Itran, a wanderer in Haxhi.
This is the last mission. You have my word.

It is time to bring Brother Egan back to St. Odwig's Mission, where he belongs. Father Dynwel should be pleased that I've found his youngest charge. The mission is south of the camp, in the village of Gorhart.
Then Brother Fallon never made it through the woods? This is terrible news. When you have a moment, you should return his prayer beads to the mission.
Welcome. I am Brother Mason, mission Alms Master. If you need anything, please don't hesitate to ask. Are you here about Brother Egan? He is still missing.

Tuesday

We broke through this morning. It was a grand adventure. I led the way, dangling from a series of cords and timbers, a puppet on a string. Exciting! I must confess that such breathtaking risks are not the usual labors of a mission father. Of course, what is but prayer? I would do it again in an instant. Exciting!

The old well was in better condition that we'd anticipated. Brother Wulf and I were able to penetrate the collapsed stone within several hours of digging, and soon reached the lake beneath. Water levels were low, likely because of the endless heat we've been experiencing in Haxhi this spring. Not a day passes that I don't pray for the health of my Sky Blossom and Cohosh. May the Authority protect them from this oppressive blaze!

As we prepared the pulley lines and removed debris, the oddest thing happened. Beneath the earth, far in the depths of the well, Wulf made an interesting discory. It was a crystal. I've seen a great many gems and stones, but I've never seen anything like this in all of my days.

It is quite obvious to me that the crystal possesses magical properties, for is surface moves with a rippling aura, like light wavering over the water, but that is all I can gather without performing more experiments. My next few days will be spent in close observation.
Follow Egan back to the mission
To the mission!
Mission Well
What kind of diplomatic mission would you like me to conduct with the Varani in Fort Olghorn?

Brother Fallon was supposed to be bringing much-needed parcels of Plagueshield medicine from St. Hadwyn's Mission. Astrid Frisk has asked me to look for him in the woods north of Didenhil, on the road to the Mission.
Mitharu watches over you. Perhaps you should spend some time at the mission. After all, everyone craves order.
The mission has locked its doors. I wonder what's going on...
I've killed Brother Til of St. Odwig's Mission, making it impossible to help him recover his collection of lost books.
That damn ‒ this whole suicide mission was his idea! And now he tries to have me killed?!
You will steal the following: the medallion from the noble, Ealfwig Grilricas in Didenhil, and the burial pall of St. Eadric, from his tomb in St. Eadric's Mission.
Myfa should be back from her diplomatic mission. I should seek her out in the Keep to hear the results.
Souldeep is a sacred place. You have fulfilled your mission. It's time to go.

Motus Mining Company
Roparzh Judoc, lead excavator

While the island of Gallows End is obviously imbued with magic, there are no native minerals worth the trouble of mining.

When our expedition first landed on the island, it was immediately obvious that it was filled with an abundance of natural resources. Upon further study however, we found that the trees were rotten and the stone unbreakable. The mission’s sorcerer found the root cause to be a cursed magic. We traced it back to the source, an Erathi altar on top of a mountain, but we were unable to open the door.

The locals were of no help. Most of them have banded together and settled the southern coast, but they all seem to be trapped into some kind of religious zealotry, worshipping a god by the name of Akara. When we get back to Adessa we will have our researcher investigate ‘Akara’ further.

There was, on the other hand, plenty to salvage. Not only had the Dverga settled here at one point, but many of their ships have washed ashore. The salvage should at least pay for this expedition, but it’s not worth another trip back to collect the rest.

We found a large harbor on the west side of the island, of Dvergan construction. If perhaps one of the other nearby islands proves fruitful, we could perhaps use these docks as a resupply point. There is also a large Dvergan keep in the middle of the island, but it is in too much a state of disrepair to be useful.

As for the tales of Dead Kel, they seem to be false. We didn’t run into him or any of his Hanged Men. There are quite a few faer gorta however, but they are a little different than the ones we see back home. They seem to be held together by roots, similar to larger ones we’ve found all over the island.

The wildlife of this island is quite dangerous. What looks like a large rock from a distance ends up being a deadly root golem upon closer inspection. We lost two men to these creatures. Additionally the caves and Dverga tunnels seem to be filled with scavs, which have already cost us one operation.

It is my recommendation that this island be removed from consideration for any new operation.

Father Dynwel of St. Odwig's Perpetual Mission is worried about his youngest monk in his care, Brother Egan. The monk disappeared into the woods north of the mission. I should explore the forest for this lost soul and learn what became of him.
How can I finish my mission?
But this was meant to be your last mission. Going back to Moon Camp won't get you anywhere now.
Without the father I would not have a place at the mission. He took it on faith that Mitharu has a larger plan for us. For me.
I was just readying a mission into the caves. The Freehold's a favorite den of the Niskaru. It's up the cliffs a ways.
Let me guess. The army has you out here on a special mission? Me, I'm just trying to live through the nights, trying to find a bit of time to myself, to explore.
The mission? I don't know much about it.
I am new to the Faelands. Until I joined the mission, I'd never even left my home village. That's why I volunteered, I wanted to see the world.
What is your mission?

From the Journal of Kleitos, historian

I am writing from Idylla’s heart. The “Concourse,” the masons call it. The wind blows bizarrely today, hammering downward on us, snuffing out nearly all of the braziers sitting in the open air, and I must press my parchment against a tablet to write comfortably. Moods are high, and all I meet today greet me with great zeal, for they know that this gale is not a natural occurrence. Arkes, our revered Primos, and his protégé, Anokatos, have cast the spell that propels our grand city ever higher into the heavens. I am among the few citizens who chose to stay in our homes to experience the rising as it occurs. After many years of braving the dangers of the Teeth of Naros beneath us, our mission is nearing its end.

We continue to ascend, and as the Teeth below grow ever more diminutive, I see the sparks of a new spell that the Primos is casting, which light the maw of the caldera in brilliant gleams. As grand as Idylla has become, the Hyperian shall be tremendous in comparison. And it rises next.
I've retrieved the Tome of Contrition from Undersea Fasting. Unfortunately, Pepin Jamane was killed during the mission. I must now return to the leader of the gnome expedition, Fastrada Tancese.
Betrayed you? Never. You forgot the mission when you died.
I am on an important mission for Templar Julius Mavern. He has sent me to recover an artifact from Bonnlach, this hulking castle, here.

Father Etair and Brother Wulf discovered some strange crystals during an excavation in the St. Eadric's Mission well. They seem to have disappeared. I should search the well first. Etair was seen fetching water just before his murder.
Oh... you've come back again. Ready for your mission? Is there anything Maire or I ‒ I... I mean....
Grim Onwig has not returned from a mission of his. I fear that he may have been captured.

Beloved, I am sorry that I will not wither in your arms, as we always planned, as we wished with our endless hearts. My mission has come to an end. My companion and I were just finishing our meditation here at the Wall of Whispers, beneath Castle Glory, when we were betrayed. Our host, the great mage Pura, has gone mad. She wants the power of the Crossing for herself. She took the ampulla. Gretan was killed outright, but I managed to escape, but not before sustaining grievous wounds. We have failed the courts, my dear. Pura will go to the Crossing and pose as one of us in an attempt to divert the flow, to change the story. What now? The Crossing Keepers will never know what befell us. Please, know I love you, and that...
You have freed Grim. That was well done of you. I heard that he is now on a mission of his own, but I know not where. I wish him well.
It was Venris' pet, and also his friend. They often went on scouting missions together. The two were inseparable.
What was Grim's mission?
An old item used to record missions of the Warsworn's mercenaries.
So you have come to me again, shade. So competent you were in your last mission, that I've prepared another for you.
This key belongs to Brother Delf of St. Odwig's Mission, and it likely opens a chest containing the valuables he stole during his time with the Red Legion.
Listen. Skald's missions are important, but none of them will matter if you don't close the Portals. To kill the Chaos you must aim for the heart.
Are you content to live among the lives of the Mission? They look down their eyes at you! They laugh at your ignorance!
Please, we're scouts, not seasoned fighters. We can't complete our mission if this Headsman continues picking us off.
You and Phasmer Humm are to steal the Amulet of Rithen. The unbeliever has been attentive, for once ‒ he is eager to prove himself, so he will help you on this mission.
If necessary I will sacrifice myself to insure that the magic here is kept safe. You have jeopardized that mission.
What is my mission again?
I've recovered all of Brother's Til's missing books. I should travel to St. Odwig's Perpetual Mission in Odarath and return them to the scripture library.
You have made our mission whole again, stranger. We cannot ever truly repay you for bringing back Brother Egan.
Pray at the shrines of St. Eadric's, St. Odwig's, and before this very Mission. At each one you pray, the beads will be improved.
The people here are kind, yet suspicious. They believe the mission harbors secrets and they're right.

During your travels you have come upon a book belonging to Brother Til, the late Scripture Master of St. Odwig's Perpetual Mission. From the looks of the titles, Til's literary interests tended toward the lewd and lascivious. Retrieve all of the missing volumes and you return them to Til's Collection for a reward.
St. Eadric's Mission
I had to lie. Rast is an innocent. She couldn't stomach what I have to do ‒ my mission of revenge.
I have read the pages of the Omnibus Arcana, and it has instructed me to go to eastern Kandrian. I should press onwards and reach this point, to conclude the mission Idris has sent me on.
Father Etair is dead, murdered. I should speak to one of the monks at the mission to find out what happened to their leader, and if there is any way I can learn what he'd been doing when he died.
St. Hadwyn's Mission
My past is a secret between you and me. No one here at the mission must ever know.
This mission was founded to aid all those seeking Mitharu's divine order. There are others, as well. St. Hadwin's is east of here, and St. Eadric's is to the south.
They're out in droves. I don't know why. But Kester might: he returned from a scouting mission not long ago.
I've sent Myfa off on a diplomatic mission. I will learn of her progress when she returns.
He leads the House of Valor justly and with blood. These games are a mockery of his mission, despite what the council says.
I know only what I've seen from this hill. The Fae are a wild race, inspired by their intimacy with the natural world. We at the mission marvel at this relationship.
Want them returned to the Mission, yes. If you would be so kind.
If you‘re not in a hurry, I suggest giving it a try before continuing with your mission.
Very well. Let me know if you'd like me to conduct a spying mission later.
His quarters are on the second floor of the mission bunkhouse. Most of his days are spent inside working on his research. I don't understand a word of it.
The spy mission went off as planned: undetected and successful.

I've agreed to work for Red Idward, and to kill Brother Delf for his crime against his bandit kin. When I kill Delf, I am welcome to his treasures, most of which were gathered during his time as a criminal. Delf is located at St. Odwig's Mission in western Odarath.
Welcome to St. Odwig's Perpetual Mission. I would invite you in, but the Order has been too trusting in the past. We try to learn from our mistakes.
Then Brother Fallon never made it through the woods? This is terrible news. When you can, you should return his prayer beads to the Mission.
Zefwyn has returned from his mission to investigate the recent shipwreck. I should visit him in the Keep Courtyard for a full report.
They sometimes send these ships out to establish new missions, so it's possible there's some building materials on board.
I hope they've fared well, up north in the Mission.
So... about that mission....
I found Brother Fallon's body by the overturned cart in Glendara wood. People in Didenhil advised me to return the beads to St. Hadwyn's Mission which is north of town, deep within the forest.
Father Dynwel and the others are fools, and their silly mission will wither and crumble. Finna and Arbos have glimpsed it with their ever-seeing eyes.

Sister Zelda wishes to be a monk in the Order of Mitharu, but the brothers of St. Odwig's Perpetual Mission have refused her membership. If I steal the Ordination Tome, I can prove that women are allowed into the Order. It is located in the Mission reliquary.
Without further ado, let's begin. By your command, I can embark on diplomatic missions to our closest neighbors across the sea.
How goes your mission?
Your presence is not required here. Move along once you've fulfilled your mission.
A much larger Mission in Gorhart, to the west. They are unmatched in venerable years of service.
Good luck on your mission.
Want them returned to the Mission, yes. If you would be so kind.
I don't know if you noticed, but St. Odwig's Mission closed its gate moments before that Fae's body turned up on the road. I don't like what that suggests. Not at all.
Ansilla was the key to the Caeled Coast, a fortress overlooking the House of Pride and the passage into Alabastra. That's where our mission ended in disaster.
What is the Mission hiding? Why are its gates forever closed? These are the questions we all should be asking!
Do you surrender to the Authority's order, and claim his mission?
I should tell you more about what mission you're to be ‒ oh, you must give me a moment. Maire, my poor, lovely Maire....
Shieldring Keep: Mission Brief
To honor and uphold the forces of order and good. Our religious mission is to see chaos and suffering laid low beneath Mitharu's hammer.

I've found the remains of a Warsworn encampment that had been destroyed by ettin. A letter carried by one of the warriors detailed a mission they were undertaking to kill four ettin Shamans that are organizing the ettin into a war party. I should complete their mission to protect Dalentarth from the potential threat of the ettin.

site_reviews.en: I was instructed by the Hierophant Shrine to steal three items in order to prove my worth to the Travelers. The items are: the Grilricas Medallion, which belongs to a noble stuck in the Didenhil Inn, the Pall of St. Eadric, resting in a sarcophagus in the nearby Almain Mission, and a pair of daggers, called Draug's Toothpicks, owned by Gunnar Frode of the Vorm Lodge, in the Sidhe.
site_reviews.ja: トラベラーにズ加わる価値のある者と証明するため、3個のアイテムを盗むよう祈祷師の聖堂で命じられた。3個のアイテムとは、ダイデンヒル宿場にいる貴族が持っているグリルリカスのメダル、近くのアルメイン修道院のサルコファガスに眠る聖イードリックの棺、シーのヴォーム・ロッジにいるガナー・フロードが所有する、ドラウグの飛び出しナイフと呼ばれるペアのダガーだ。
site_reviews.zh: 为了证明我对旅行者的价值，大祭司神龛指示我要窃取三件物品。这些物品是：格瑞里加斯奖章，归一个被困在迪登希尔酒店的贵族所有；圣艾德里克的棺材，就在附近阿尔曼布道所的石棺里；还有一对匕首，叫做德拉格的剔牙刀，它属于在仙境的沃姆旅馆里的冈纳·弗劳德。

site_reviews.before: 미사루(Mitharu)는 선교회 담장 뒤에 머무르지 않아. 아니야. 모든 바위와 나무, 모든 꽃봉오리와 폭풍 속에 계셔. 우리 모두와 함께하셔!
site_reviews.after: 미사루(Mitharu)는 선교원 담장 뒤에 머무르지 않아. 아니야. 모든 바위와 나무, 모든 꽃봉오리와 폭풍 속에 계셔. 우리 모두와 함께하셔!
site_reviews.en: Mitharu does not dwell behind the Mission's walls. No. She is in every rock and every tree, every bud and every storm. She is with all of us!
site_reviews.ja: ミサールは修道院の壁の向こうになんかいない。どの岩にも、どの木にも、どの芽にも、その嵐にも存在する！ 私たちと共にあるのよ！
site_reviews.zh: 米萨鲁并不存在于布道所的墙后面。不。她在每一块岩石、每一棵树、每一个花蕾以及每一场风暴中。她和我们在一起！

site_reviews.before: 우리의 소박한 선교단을 보라. 태초의 물처럼 순수하고 담백하도다!
site_reviews.after: 우리의 소박한 선교원을 보라. 태초의 물처럼 순수하고 담백하도다!
site_reviews.en: Behold our unassuming Mission. Pure and simple as the very first waters!
site_reviews.ja: この慎ましい修道院をご覧あれ。最高級の宝石のように清らかで無駄がない
site_reviews.zh: 看看我们谦逊的布道团。纯洁而简单，就像最初的水！

site_reviews.before: 언덕 위 선교회에 있는 저 바보들은 시간을 허비하고 있어. 그런 힘을 지닌 존재들이 신을 숭배할 리 없지. 그들 자신이 신이니까.
site_reviews.after: 언덕 위 선교원에 있는 저 바보들은 시간을 허비하고 있어. 그런 힘을 지닌 존재들이 신을 숭배할 리 없지. 그들 자신이 신이니까.
site_reviews.en: Those fools in that mission on the hill are wasting their days. Creatures of such power do not worship gods. They are gods.
site_reviews.ja: 丘の上にある修道院の馬鹿どもは、無駄な日々を送っている。大いなる力を持つ者は、神を崇拝したりしない。自らが神だからな
site_reviews.zh: 山上布道所里的那些傻瓜完全是在浪费人生。这样强大的种族是不可能崇拜神灵的。他们是诸神啊。

site_reviews.before: 난 그들이 정말 흥미로워. 예복부터 별난 습관과 태도까지 말이야. 어제만 해도 알마인(Almain) 선교회 소속 수도사가 덤불 사이로 몰래 지나가는 걸 봤어.

site_reviews.en: I find them so interesting, from their vestments to their odd habits and demeanors. Just yesterday I saw a monk from the Almain mission sneaking through the underbrush.
site_reviews.ja: あの法衣も変な習慣も、おかしな振る舞いも、何もかもが面白いの。そういえば昨日、アルメインの修道院からきた修道士が低木をくぐり抜けてるところをみたわ
site_reviews.zh: 他们真的很有意思，包括各种衣装，还有古怪的习惯和举止。就在昨天，我看见阿尔曼布道所的一个僧侣，借着树丛偷偷溜了出去。

site_reviews.en: Help me to expose the Mission for what it truly is: a prison of ideas in which they hope to keep us locked away forever. But I tell you, your mind must not be caged!
site_reviews.ja: 修道院の正体を暴くために手を貸して。永遠に私たちの意思を閉じ込めようとしている監獄よ。でも言っておくわ。あなたの思いは閉じ込められない！
site_reviews.zh: 请帮助我揭露布道所的真相：它是一座思想的监狱，他们希望把我们永远关在里面。但我告诉你们，你们的心不可以被关住！

site_reviews.before: 성 오드윅(St. Odwig) 선교원의 델프 수사(Brother Delf)가 도적단장 레드 이드워드(Red Idward)를 죽여 달라고 했다. 탈영한 델프(Delf)에게 복수하려는 자다. 하지만 행동에 나서기 전에 델프(Delf)와 함께 탈영한 이들에게 레드 리전(Red Legion) 단검에 관해 물어봐야 한다. 우그나르(Ugnar)는 고어하트(Gorhart) 마을에, 이트란(Itran)은 동쪽 하크시(Haxhi)에 있다.

site_reviews.en: Brother Delf, of St. Odwig's Mission, has asked me to kill the bandit captain, Red Idward, who, in turn, wants to kill Delf for deserting. Before I can act, I must speak with Delf's fellow deserters about their Red Legion daggers. Ugnar is in Gorhart Village, and Itran is east in Haxhi.
site_reviews.ja: 聖オドウィグ修道院のブラザー・デルフに、盗賊を抜けたことで命を狙われている盗賊の首領レッド・イドワードを殺すよう頼まれた。その仕事の前に、レッドリージョン団のダガーの件でデルフと一緒に盗賊を抜けた者に会わねばならない。ウグナーはゴーハート村、アイトランは東のハクシにいる。
site_reviews.zh: 圣奥德威格布道所的德尔夫修士，请求我杀死强盗头目雷德·伊德瓦尔德，他想要为当初的抛弃向德尔夫复仇。在我开始行动之前，我必须与德尔夫的前同伴们聊聊雷德帮匕首的事情。乌格纳在郭哈特镇，伊特兰在哈克希东部。

site_reviews.before: 남쪽 멀리 시드(Sidhe) 깊은 곳에 있는 멋진 선교원이야. 안타깝게도 그곳에 간 지 여러 해가 됐지.
site_reviews.after: 남쪽 멀리 시드(Sidhe) 깊은 곳에 있는 멋진 선교원이야. 안타깝게도 그곳에 간 지 여러 해가 됐지.
site_reviews.en: A lovely mission, far to the south, in the depths of the Sidhe. It's been many years since I've been there, I'm afraid.
site_reviews.ja: はるか南、シーの奥地にある素晴らしい修道院だ。残念ながら、もう何年もあそこには足を運んでいない
site_reviews.zh: 一个美好的布道团，远在南方，在仙境的深处。恐怕我离开那里已经很多年了。

site_reviews.before:
에이버리(Avery),

네 가족을 돌보러 고어하트(Gorhart)에 왔어. 네가 말한 대로 리카(Rikka)는 정말 훌륭하더군. 하지만 지금은 그림자처럼 지내고 있어.

리카(Rikka)는 자네를 그리워해, 친구. 우리 모두 그렇지. 자네가 곁에 있어 주지 못하니 내가 그녀를 보살필게. 자주 찾아가겠네. 이놈의 전쟁 같으니.

내가 선교지에 들어가 감옥 대신 수도원을 택하게 될 줄 누가 알았겠나? 우리 둘 다 탈출했더라면 좋았을 텐데. 하지만 창살은 너무 튼튼했고 투아사(Tuatha)족은 너무 잔혹했어.

전우,
메이슨

site_reviews.en:
Avery,

I came to Gorhart to look after your kin. Rikka is as wonderful as you described. Yet she is a shadow.

She misses you, my friend. As do we all. I will watch over her since you cannot. And I will visit you often. This war be damned.

Who would have guessed I would come to a mission, and trade a prison for a cloister? If only we had both escaped. Alas, the bars were too strong, the Tuatha too cruel.

Your brother in arms,
Mason
site_reviews.ja:
エイブリー

君の家族の面倒を見に、ゴーハートへやって来た。リッカは君の話したとおり美しい女性だが、今の彼女は影でしかない。

リッカが寂しがっていた。皆そうだ。君の代わりに、私が彼女を見守ってやる。君にもちょくちょく会いに行こう。こんな戦争、なかったらいいのに。

私が出家するなんて誰が考えたろうな？ 監獄の代わりに修道院に入るなんて。二人とも逃げられたらよかったのに。だが、牢の柱はあまりに頑丈で、ツアサはあまりに無慈悲だった。

君の義兄弟
メイソン
site_reviews.zh:
艾弗里,

我来郭哈特是为了照顾你的亲人。丽卡和你描述的一样优秀。然而她只是个影子。

她很想你，我的朋友。我们都想你。既然你没法照顾她，就让我来照顾她。我会经常来看你。这场战争真该死。

谁能想到我会去布道团，监狱换成了修道院呢？要是我们俩都逃了出来就好了。唉，铁栏太结实，图阿撒人太残忍。

你的战友，
梅森

site_reviews.zh: 我已经进入了圣艾德里克布道所，开始寻找埃泰尔神父和伍尔夫修士在开采中发现的水晶。无论这些水晶究竟是什么，它们对于少女的计划都很重要。

From the looks of the titles on the remaining books, Til's literary interests tended toward the lewd and lascivious. You may retrieve all of the missing volumes and return them to Til's Collection for a reward.
site_reviews.ja: 施錠されたこの書架には聖オドウィグ終身修道院で経典長を務めていた、今は亡きブラザー・ティルの蔵書が収められている。残っている著作の題名から判断するに、ティルの文学的興味はわいせつでみだらな方面に傾倒していたようだ。なくなっている本を全て集めてティルの蔵書に戻せば報酬が得られるだろう。
site_reviews.zh: 这个上锁的书架收藏了圣奥德威格的永恒布道所已故经文大师蒂尔修士的作品。从其余书籍的标题来看，蒂尔的文学爱好倾向于淫荡和色情。你可以找回所有丢失的卷册，并将它们归还到蒂尔的收藏中赢得奖励。

site_reviews.zh: 欢迎回来。如果你想进入布道所，就需要为布道所效劳，而伊根修士仍然不知所踪。

site_reviews.zh: 神龛一片寂静，但你想起了大祭司让你去偷的东西：迪登希尔，埃夫维格·格瑞里加斯的勋章；圣艾德里克的永恒布道所里的圣艾德里克的裹尸布；还有目前在仙境的冈纳·弗劳德手里的德拉格的剔牙刀——一对匕首。

site_reviews.zh: 迪恩维尔神父说我在这个布道所的前途不可限量。我洗碗更有劲了。他的话。

site_reviews.before:
여름, 6일째, 새벽

오늘은 별일 없었다. 여정은 이제 막 시작됐고 숲은 아직 외지인에게 꽤 너그럽다. 경고를 무시한 건 현명한 선택이었다. 경쟁자는 없다. 아만(Amman)의 열쇠를 찾는 건 나만의 몫이고, 찾는 건 시간문제일 뿐이다. 숲 곳곳의 아만(Amman) 조각상들이 나를 비웃는다. 열쇠만 손에 넣으면 조각상들을 열고 보물을 차지할 수 있다. 곧 그렇게 될 것이다.

여름, 13일째, 해질녘

오다라스(Odarath)는 늘 들었던 대로 아름답다. 특히 성 오드윅 영구 선교원(St. Odwig's Perpetual Mission) 북쪽의 위험한 땅이 그렇다. 스프라이트에게 거의 당할 뻔했다! 고어하트(Gorhart)에서 온 용감한 마을 사람이 나타나 구해 주지 않았다면 말이다. 그는 자신을 우그나르 오드그레이(Ugnar Odgray)라고 소개했다. 참 별난 이름이다. 바라니(Varani)가 아니면 그런 이름을 가질 리가 없다.

여름, 67일째, 새벽

오늘 발라드의 집(House of Ballads)의 영지를 방문했다! 성인이 된 뒤로 줄곧 이 전설적인 인물들을 연구해 왔으니, 잠깐이라도 볼 수 있다면 먼 길을 온 보람이 있다. 아만(Amman)의 열쇠 하나가 높은 성벽 안에 있을 거라는 생각이 들기 시작했다. 내 연구가 맞다면 곧 열쇠가 있는 곳을 알아낼 수 있을 것이다.

여름, 83일째, 해질녘

해냈다! 아데사(Adessa)의 연대기를 몇 년이나 뒤지고 페이(Fae)의 땅을 샅샅이 조사한 끝에, 마침내 전설 속 아만(Amman)의 열쇠 다섯 개 중 하나를 손에 넣었다!

이제 나머지 네 개만 찾으면 된다....

site_reviews.en:
Summer, Day 6, Daybreak

Nothing today. My journey is young and the forest remains fairly hospitable to outsiders. Ignoring the warnings was a wise decision. There are no rivals. The search for Amman's keys belongs to me, and me alone. It is only a matter of time. The statues of Amman litter the forest, taunting me. If I can just secure the keys, I will be able to open them and partake of their treasures. Soon.

Summer, Day 13, Dusk

Odarath is as beautiful as I have always heard, especially the perilous lands north of St. Odwig's Perpetual Mission. I was almost struck down by a sprite! That is until a brave villager from Gorhart arrived on the scene to act as my savior. He introduced himself as Ugnar Odgray. Such an odd name, it could only belong to a Varani.

Summer, Day 67, Daybreak

I visited the House of Ballads grounds today! All of my adult life has been spent learning about these legendary figures, so even a slight glimpse was worth the trip. I am beginning to believe that one of Amman's keys lies behind its high walls. If my scholarly work has been done correctly, the location of the keys will soon be known to me.

Summer, Day 83, Dusk

I have done it! At long last, after years searching in the annals of Adessa and scouring the fae lands, I have secured one of the five fabled keys of Amman!

Now only if I could find the other four....
site_reviews.ja:
夏、6日目、夜明け

今日は何もない。旅は始まったばかりだし、この森は今のところよそ者に対しても優しい。警告を無視して正解だった。ライバルは一人もいない。アマンの鍵を探す者は私だけ。発見は時間の問題だろう。森のあちこちに立つアマンの像が私を挑発してくる。鍵さえ見つけたら、中のお宝を頂戴できる。もうすぐだ。

夏、13日目、夕暮れ

オダラスは噂にたがわぬ美しい場所だ。とりわけ、聖オドウィグ終身修道院の北側の危険なエリアは素晴らしい。危うくスプライトに殺されるところだった。ゴーハートの勇敢な村人が救助に駆けつけてくれなかったら、死んでいただろう。ウグナー・オドグレイ。彼はそう自己紹介した。変わった名だ。そういう名を持つのはヴラニだけだ。

夏、67日目、夜明け

今日はハウス・オブ・バラードの庭を訪れた。大人になってからの私は、このハウスの偉人たちの研究に全ての時間を注いできた。それゆえ、一目見られただけでも、この旅に出た価値はあった。思うに、アマンの鍵の1つは、この高い壁の内側にあるような気がする。私の研究が正しければ、もうじき鍵の在り処が判明する。

夏、83日目、夕暮れ

やったぞ。何年もかけてアデッサの記録を読み調べ、フェイの土地を探し歩いた結果、ついに伝説のアマンの鍵を5本手に入れた！

後は残りの4本を探すだけだ…
site_reviews.zh:
夏天，第6天，黎明

今天无事发生。我的旅程才刚刚开始，森林对外人来说还是相当友好的。无视这些警告是一个明智的决定。这里没有敌人。寻找安曼的钥匙的旅程只属于我一个人。找到它们只是时间问题。安曼的雕像散布在森林里，嘲弄着我。如果我能找到钥匙，我就能打开它们，拿走它们的宝藏。快了。

夏天，第13天，黄昏

欧达拉斯就和我听闻的一样美丽，尤其是圣奥德威格的永恒布道所北部的危险地带。我差点被一只妖精击倒！直到一位来自郭哈特的勇敢村民来到现场，救了我的命。他自称乌格纳·奥德格雷。这么奇怪的名字，只可能属于瓦拉尼人。

夏天，第67天，破晓

我今天拜访了歌谣家族的领地！我的整个成年生活都花在了解这些传奇人物上了，所以哪怕只是看一眼都是值得的。我开始相信安曼的一把钥匙就藏在高高的城墙后面。如果我的学术工作做得正确，我很快就会知道钥匙的位置了。

夏天，第83天，黄昏

我做到了！多年来，我在阿德萨的编年史中寻觅，在灵族大陆四处寻找，终于找到了安曼传说中的五把钥匙中的一把！

现在，如果我能再找到另外四把就好了……

site_reviews.before:
목요일

이상한 수정이 내 책상 위에 놓여 있다. 눈을 뗄 수가 없다. 숭배하거나 매료되어서가 아니다. 긴장과 불길한 공포에 사로잡혀서다. 밤에 침상에 누워 있을 때조차 그 공포는 사라지지 않는다. 저주받은 것을 지하에서 끌어올린 탓에 어린 제자들을 파멸로 몰아넣은 건 아닐까 두렵다.

가장 걱정스러운 건 이 수정이 어린 울프 수사(Brother Wulf)에게 미치는 영향이다. 방 건너편에 앉은 이 사람은 더는 총명하고 다정한 내 제자가 아니다. 눈빛이 흐리멍덩한 광신자가 되어 버렸다. 수정의 기묘한 매력이 그의 정신 깊은 곳까지 스며들었다. 며칠째 예배당에도 오지 않았다. 씻지도, 먹지도 않는다. 이름을 불러도 대답하지 않고, 주변 사람들을 알아차리더라도 퉁명스러운 비웃음만 던진다. 나는 죽은 이를 애도하듯 그를 슬퍼한다. 온종일 수정만 바라보거나 수정을 향해 피리를 불어 소용돌이치는 붉은 표면을 번쩍이게 한다. 내 기도는 아무 소용이 없다.

모든 연구와 훈련에도 내가 찾는 답은 나오지 않았다. 이 기묘한 물질은 무엇이며 어디서 마력을 얻는 걸까? 누가 만들었고 어떻게 우리 선교회 지하에 오게 됐을까? 무엇보다 소중한 친구를 해치지 않고 이걸 어떻게 없앨 수 있을까? 질문은 많지만 답은 없다.

내일은 미사루(Mitharu)께서 답을 주실지도 모른다. 그분은 아직 나를 실망시키지 않으셨다.

site_reviews.en:
Thursday

The strange crystal sits atop my desk. I cannot take my eyes from it. It is not out of adoration, or even fascination, but out of a tense, foreboding dread that never escapes me, not even as I lay in my bunk at night hoping that I have not doomed my young charges by bringing this cursed thing up from the underground.

Perhaps the most troubling development is how the crystal affects young Brother Wulf. This person sitting across the chamber from me is no longer my bright, friendly apprentice, but a heavy-eyed fanatic. The strange allure of the crystal has touched him on some spiritual level. He has not been to chapel in days. He has not bathed or eaten. He does not respond to his name, and when does take notice of the others around him, he does so with a gruff sneer. I grieve for him as one mourns the deceased. All day long he stares at the crystal, or plays to it with his whistle, making the swirling red surface flash. My prayers do nothing.

All of my research, all of my training, none of it has provided the answers I seek. What is this strange substance and from where does it derive its magic? What created it and how did it come to be beneath our mission? Better yet, how I can I get dispose of it without hurting my dear friend? So many questions, but no answers come.

Perhaps tomorrow Mitharu will provide. He has yet to disappoint me.
site_reviews.ja:
木曜日

奇妙なクリスタルは私の机の上にある。それから目が離せない。崇敬の念からではない。魅了されているわけでも。ただただ精神が張りつめていて、いくらやっても振り払えない不吉な恐怖心のせいで目が離せないのだ。夜、寝ている時ですらそうだ。私がこの邪なものを地下から持ち帰ったせいで、私の若き門弟たちが凶事に見舞われなければよいが。

特に気がかりなのは、このクリスタルの、若きブラザー・ウルフへの影響だ。部屋の中で私の真向いに座っているこの人物は、今ではもう将来を嘱望される人懐こい弟子ではなく、目が座った狂信者だった。彼は精神的なレベルでこのクリスタルの奇妙な誘引力に触れていた。ここ数日は礼拝にも来ず、風呂も入らず、食事もとらない。名前を呼んでも知らんぷりで、周りに人がいることに気づくとようやく、嫌らしい笑みを浮かべて返事をするのだ。私は人が死者を嘆き悲しむように、彼のことを深く悲しんでいた。彼は一日中、クリスタルをじっと見つめているか、口笛を吹きながら弄んでいる。渦を巻くクリスタルの表面が赤くきらめく。私の祈りは何の意味もなさない。

どんな調査も、どんな修行も、私が求めている答えを与えてはくれない。この奇妙な物体は一体何なんだ？ どこから魔力を得ている？ 誰が作った？ なぜ私の前に現れた？ 私の大切な友を傷つける事なく、どうやって処分すればいい？ 次々と質問が湧いてきたが、答えは一つも見つからない。

明日になればミサールが答えてくれるかも。ミサールは決して私を失望させない。
site_reviews.zh:
周四

那块奇怪的水晶就在我的桌子上。我的眼睛无法离开它。这并不是出于崇拜，甚至不是出于迷恋，而是出于一种紧张的、不祥的恐惧，这种恐惧永远不会从我的脑海中消失，即使我晚上躺在床上，希望我没有把这该死的东西从地下带出来，从而使我年轻的孩子们young charges完蛋。

也许最麻烦的事情是水晶如何影响年轻的伍尔夫修士的。坐在我对面的这个人不再是我聪明、友好的学徒，而是一个目光呆滞的狂热分子。水晶的奇异魅力在某种精神层面上触动了他。他已经几天没去做礼拜了。他不洗澡，也不吃东西。他对自己的名字没有反应，当他注意到周围的人时，他会发出粗噶的冷笑。我为他哀悼，就像人们哀悼死者一样。他整天盯着水晶，或者吹着口哨玩弄它，使它旋转的红色表面闪闪发光。我的祈祷没用。

我所有的研究，所有的训练，都没有提供我想要的答案。这种奇怪的物质是什么？它的魔力从何而来？是什么创造了它，它是如何在我们的布道团之下的？更重要的是，我怎样才能在不伤害我亲爱的朋友的情况下把它处理掉呢？这么多问题，却没有答案。

也许明天米萨鲁会给我答案。他还没有让我失望过。

보석이란 진정 무엇인지 생각해 보길 바란다. 질서와 명료함을 구현한 것, 힘과 빛을 전달하는 통로다. 그렇다면 보석 조각은 무엇인가? 보석이 될 수는 있지만, 아직은 질서도 명료함도 힘도 갖추지 못했다.

필멸자들이 보석과 조각을 얼마나 닮았는지 생각해 보라! 우리는 거칠게 다듬어지지 않은 채 하찮은 존재로 이 세상에 태어나지만, 부지런히 노력하고 스스로를 갈고닦아 미사루(Mitharu)의 빛을 전하는 찬란한 통로가 될 수 있다.

게으른 사람이나 방종한 습관에 빠진 사람은 세상에서 힘을 발휘하지 못한다. 잘해 봐야 아무것도 이루지 못하고, 최악의 경우 큰 해를 끼친다. 미사루(Mitharu)께서 그런 이들을 사랑하실 리 있겠는가. 그러나 부지런하고 근면하며 뚜렷한 목표를 지닌 이들은 위대한 일을 이루고 세상에 명예와 순수함을 가져온다. 그들이야말로 질서의 신을 진정으로 받드는 이들이다.

이 점도 생각해 보라. 우리 중 흠 없는 보석, 다시 말해 성인은 얼마나 드문가. 그런데도 불완전한 우리는 마법물품 제작의 기술로 보석 조각을 완벽한 보석으로 만든다. 이것이야말로 연약한 조각인 우리에게 미사루(Mitharu)께서 주신 선물이 아니겠는가. 마법물품 제작(Sagecraft)의 수련은 이 모든 가르침을 깊이 되새기는 훌륭한 수행이기도 하다.

site_reviews.en:
By Brother Gamian of St. Hadwyn's Undying Mission

I ask you to consider what a gem truly is. Order and clarity, exemplified. A conduit of might and light. What then is a shard? It can become a gem, but as yet, it is neither ordered, nor clear, nor powerful.

Think now how much mortal-kind are like unto gems and shards! Though we enter this world rough-hewn and of little worth, we may work hard, we may refine ourselves until we become shining conduits of Mitharu's Light.

A lazy man or a woman of wayward habits is a thing of little force in the world. At best, they accomplish nothing; at worst, they do great harm. Surely Mitharu loves them not. But those who are dilligent, industrious, and clear of focus. It is they who achieve great things, bring honor and purity to the world. They are truly champions of the god of order.

Consider this, as well: how few of us are are perfect gems ‒ by which I mean, saints ‒ and yet, imperfect as we are, by way of the sage's craft, we make perfect gems from shards. Truly this is Mitharu's gift to we frail shards. And truly the practice of sagecraft is an excellent meditation on all these lessons.
site_reviews.ja:
聖ハドウィン終身修道院、ブラザー・ギャミアン記

ジェムの本質は何であるのか、自問してみていただきたい。秩序と明晰の具現化。力と光を伝えるもの。となればジェムのシャードは何であろうか。ジェムになりうるが、そのままでは秩序立ってもおらず、明晰でもなく、力強くもない。

今度は、定命の者たちがいかにジェムやシャードのようであるかを考えていただきたい。我々は荒削りで価値の低い状態でこの世に生まれ出るものの、多大な努力を通じて精進し、ミサールの光を伝える輝かしい存在になりうるのだ。

怠惰な性質の人物は、この世において微々たる力しか持ちえない。よくても何も達成しないのが関の山で、最悪の場合は多大な危害をもたらす。ミサールがそのような者を愛するだろうか。しかし勤勉で努力家で、明確な目標をもって生きる者たちは、偉大なる業績をおさめ、世界に誇りと純粋さをもたらし、秩序の神の真の使徒というべき存在となる。

同時に考えていただきたいのは、我々の間に非の打ち所のないジェム、すなわち聖人が、いかに少ないかということ。そして、不完全でありながら、我々が宝石術の技をもってジェムのシャードから完ぺきなるジェムを作り出せること。これこそが我々もろいジェムのシャードに対するミサールの贈り物ではないだろうかと。そして宝石術の修練は、これらの教訓を熟考する素晴らしき機会なのではないかと。
site_reviews.zh:
圣哈德温永恒布道团的加米安修士所著

我请你们想想宝石到底是什么。秩序和清晰的例证。光明与力量的信物。那么碎晶是什么呢？它可以成为一块宝石，但目前，它既不有序，也不清晰，也不强大。

现在想想，多少的凡人就像宝石和碎晶一样！虽然我们进入这个世界时是粗陋的，没有什么价值，但我们可以努力工作，我们可以完善自己，直到我们成为米萨鲁之光的信物。

一个懒惰的男人或有任性习惯的女人在这个世界上是没有力量的。往好了说，他们会一事无成；在最坏的情况下，他们会造成巨大的伤害。米萨鲁肯定不爱他们。而是那些勤奋、勤劳、清晰的人。是他们成就了伟大的事业，给世界带来了荣誉和纯洁。他们是秩序之神的真正拥护者。

再想想这一点：我们中有多少人是完美的宝石——我指的是，圣人——然而，尽管我们不完美，通过圣人之道，我们可以从碎晶变成完美的宝石。这确实是米萨鲁赐给我们脆弱碎晶的礼物。确实，附魔的实践是对所有这些教训的一种极好的沉思。

site_reviews.en:
Avery,

Mitharu has made it known to me. I must leave St. Odwig's Mission, and Odarath. You see, I am in love, and that love is forbidden. Not only does my Order frown upon such earthly concerns, but such an act would dishonor you, as well. "Why?" you may ask. I cannot love this woman because it is Rikka. It is your wife.

So I am taking leave of the mission, abandoning my post as Alms Master. Perhaps one day I will return, but not in disgrace. I cannot do that to you, or to Rikka, or to my master, Mitharu.

Farewell, my friend and brother. Rest in good peace. Soft peace. Peace without further pain.

Your brother in arms forever,
Mason

エイブリー

ミサールのお告げがあった。私は聖オドウィグの修道院を去らなければならない。オダラスを。実は恋をしていてね。禁断の恋を。そうした世俗的な悩みは同胞のちょう笑を浴びるのみならず、君の名誉を傷つけることにもなる。"なぜ？"かって？ 私がこの女性を愛せないのは、彼女がリッカだから。君の妻だからだよ。

だから私は修道院を出る。托鉢の師としての地位も捨てる。いつか戻ってくるかもしれないが、それは恥を雪いでからだ。君に迷惑はかけられない。リッカにも、我が主ミサールにも。

さらばだ、我が友、我が兄弟。安らかに眠れ。穏やかに。これ以上苦しむ必要はない。

君の永遠の義兄弟
メイソン

화요일

오늘 아침 마침내 돌파구를 찾았다. 대단한 모험이었다. 나는 여러 줄과 목재에 매달려 꼭두각시처럼 흔들리며 앞장섰다. 짜릿했다! 고백하건대, 그렇게 숨 막히는 위험은 선교관 신부의 일상적인 업무가 아니다. 물론 기도 말고 무엇이 있겠는가? 당장이라도 다시 해보고 싶다. 정말 짜릿했다!

옛 우물은 예상보다 상태가 좋았다. 울프 수사(Brother Wulf)와 나는 몇 시간 동안 파내 무너진 돌 틈을 통과했고, 곧 아래쪽 호수에 닿았다. 수위가 낮았다. 이번 봄 하크시(Haxhi)를 덮친 끝없는 더위 때문일 것이다. 하늘꽃(Sky Blossom)과 코호시가 건강하기를 하루도 빠짐없이 기도한다. 권능자여, 이 숨 막히는 불볕에서 그들을 지켜주소서!

도르래 줄을 준비하고 잔해를 치우던 중 가장 기묘한 일이 벌어졌다. 땅속, 우물 깊숙한 곳에서 울프(Wulf)가 흥미로운 것을 발견했다. 수정이었다. 보석과 돌은 숱하게 봤지만, 평생 이런 것은 본 적이 없다.

그 수정에 마력이 깃들어 있음은 분명하다. 표면에서 물 위에 흔들리는 빛처럼 잔물결치는 기운이 움직인다. 하지만 실험을 더 해보지 않고는 그 이상 알아낼 수 없다. 앞으로 며칠은 가까이에서 자세히 관찰해야겠다.

site_reviews.en:
Tuesday

We broke through this morning. It was a grand adventure. I led the way, dangling from a series of cords and timbers, a puppet on a string. Exciting! I must confess that such breathtaking risks are not the usual labors of a mission father. Of course, what is but prayer? I would do it again in an instant. Exciting!

The old well was in better condition that we'd anticipated. Brother Wulf and I were able to penetrate the collapsed stone within several hours of digging, and soon reached the lake beneath. Water levels were low, likely because of the endless heat we've been experiencing in Haxhi this spring. Not a day passes that I don't pray for the health of my Sky Blossom and Cohosh. May the Authority protect them from this oppressive blaze!

As we prepared the pulley lines and removed debris, the oddest thing happened. Beneath the earth, far in the depths of the well, Wulf made an interesting discory. It was a crystal. I've seen a great many gems and stones, but I've never seen anything like this in all of my days.

It is quite obvious to me that the crystal possesses magical properties, for is surface moves with a rippling aura, like light wavering over the water, but that is all I can gather without performing more experiments. My next few days will be spent in close observation.
site_reviews.ja:
火曜

今朝、ついにやった。大変な冒険だった。無数の縄や木の枝につかまり、操り人形のようになりながら、私は先に進んだ。ゾクゾクした！ 正直に言うと、伝道師をしていてそこまでハラハラするような危険を冒すことはまずない。当たり前だが、祈ってばかりだ。次があるならすぐにでもやりたい。実に刺激的だった！

その古井戸は思ったよりも状態がよかった。ブラザー・ウルフと私とで何時間か掘り続けて、崩れた石の隙間を通り抜けることができた。そして地底湖に到達した。水位は低い。この春、ハクシを見舞っている酷暑のせいだろう。我がスカイブロッサムとコホシュの健康を祈らない日など一日としてない。"創造主"よ、この抑圧的な炎からお守りたまえ！

滑車のケーブルを引き、ガレキを取り除いていると、とても奇妙な事が起きた。この地の底で、井戸のはるか奥深くで、ウルフが興味深い発見をしたのだ。それはクリスタルだった。立派な宝石や石ならいくらでも見た事があるが、これほどの代物は初めてだった。

そのクリスタルが魔力を秘めているのは明白だ。水の上で明かりを振ったときのように、クリスタルの表面でオーラが波打っている。だが、あとは実験を重ねてみないと何とも言えない。数日かけてじっくり観察してみたい。
site_reviews.zh:
周二

我们在今天早上取得了突破。这是一次伟大的冒险。我走在前面，挂在一串绳子和木头上，像一个被吊在绳子上的木偶。真令人兴奋！我必须承认，这种惊险的冒险并非一个布道神父的日常工作。当然了，除了祈祷还有什么是呢？我向马上再做一次。真令人兴奋！

这口老井的状况比我们预期的要好。我和伍尔夫修士只挖了几个小时，就挖通了坍塌的石头，很快就抵达了下面的湖里。水位很低，可能是因为今年春天的哈克希经历了无尽的高温。没有一天我不在为我的天空之花和升麻的健康祈祷。愿当局保护它们免受这场凶猛的大火的危害！

在我们准备滑轮线和清除碎片时，最奇怪的事情发生了。在地下，在井的深处，伍尔夫有了一个有趣的发现。那是一块水晶。我见过很多宝石和石头，但我从来没见过这样的东西。

我能明显看出，这块水晶具有魔法属性，因为它的表面有着涟漪状波动的光环，就像光在水面上摇摆一样，但这仅仅是我在没有做更多实验的情况下获得的信息。接下来的几天我将仔细观察。

site_reviews.en: Brother Fallon was supposed to be bringing much-needed parcels of Plagueshield medicine from St. Hadwyn's Mission. Astrid Frisk has asked me to look for him in the woods north of Didenhil, on the road to the Mission.
site_reviews.ja: 聖ハドウィンの修道院の使いとして、ブラザー・ファロンが大切なプラーグシールドの薬を届けることになっていた。ダイデンヒルの北の森を抜ける教会への道を探すよう、アストリッド・フリスクに頼まれた。
site_reviews.zh: 法伦修士本应从圣哈德温修道院带来几包瘟疫屏障药物。阿斯特丽德·弗里斯克希望我前往迪登希尔北部的森林里寻找他，就在前往修道院的路上。

site_reviews.before: 미사루(Mitharu)께서 지켜보고 계셔. 선교관에서 시간을 보내는 게 어떻겠나? 결국 모두가 질서를 바라니까.
site_reviews.after: 미사루(Mitharu)께서 지켜보고 계셔. 선교원에서 시간을 보내는 게 어떻겠나? 결국 모두가 질서를 바라니까.
site_reviews.en: Mitharu watches over you. Perhaps you should spend some time at the mission. After all, everyone craves order.
site_reviews.ja: ミサールが見守っている。修道院でしばらく過ごしてはどうだ。結局のところ、誰もが秩序を求めている
site_reviews.zh: 米萨鲁在看着你。也许你应该在布道所花一些时间。毕竟，每个人都渴望秩序。

site_reviews.before: 성 이드릭(St. Eadric) 선교관에 온 걸 환영한다, 아이야. 어디에나 마법이 있으니, 눈여겨보기만 하면 보일 거란다.
site_reviews.after: 성 이드릭(St. Eadric) 선교원에 온 걸 환영한다, 아이야. 어디에나 마법이 있으니, 눈여겨보기만 하면 보일 거란다.
site_reviews.en: Welcome to St. Eadric's. There is magic everywhere, child, you need only to look and you will see it.
site_reviews.ja: 聖イードリックへようこそ。ここは魔法あふれる場所だ。見てさえいれば、それが分かるはずだ
site_reviews.zh: 欢迎来到圣艾德里克布道所。魔法无处不在，孩子，你只要好好看看就能看见了。

site_reviews.before: 선교회가 문을 걸어 잠갔어. 무슨 일인지 궁금하네...
site_reviews.after: 선교원이 문을 걸어 잠갔어. 무슨 일인지 궁금하네...
site_reviews.en: The mission has locked its doors. I wonder what's going on...
site_reviews.ja: 修道院が門を閉ざしたわ。何が起きたのかしら...
site_reviews.zh: 布道所锁上了大门。我在想发生了什么……

site_reviews.before: 성 오드윅 선교원(St. Odwig's Mission)의 틸 수사(Brother Til)를 죽였다. 그가 잃어버린 장서들을 되찾도록 도울 수 없게 되었다.
site_reviews.after: 성 오드윅 선교원(St. Odwig's Mission)의 틸 수사(Brother Til)를 죽였다. 그가 잃어버린 장서들을 되찾도록 도울 수 없게 되었다.
site_reviews.en: I've killed Brother Til of St. Odwig's Mission, making it impossible to help him recover his collection of lost books.
site_reviews.ja: 聖オドウィグ修道院のブラザー・ティルを殺した。行方不明の本のコレクションの捜索に協力できなくなった。
site_reviews.zh: 我杀死了圣奥德威格布道所的蒂尔修士，无法再帮助他找回丢失的藏书了。

site_reviews.before: 성 오드윅 선교회(St. Odwig's) 사람들은 이 언덕에 터전을 마련하려고 여러 해 동안 노력해 왔어. 그 과정이 순탄하지만은 않았어.
site_reviews.after: 성 오드윅 선교원(St. Odwig's) 사람들은 이 언덕에 터전을 마련하려고 여러 해 동안 노력해 왔어. 그 과정이 순탄하지만은 않았어.
site_reviews.en: We at St. Odwig's have worked for years to establish a presence on this hill. It has not been without its challenges.
site_reviews.ja: 聖オドウィグ修道院の者は、この丘での地位を確立するために何年も働いてきた。困難がなかったわけじゃない
site_reviews.zh: 我们在圣奥德威格奋斗多年，才在这座山上站稳脚跟。并非没有挑战。

site_reviews.before: 다음 물건을 훔쳐야 한다. 다이덴힐(Didenhil)의 귀족 이얼프위그 그릴리카스(Ealfwig Grilricas)의 메달, 그리고 성 이드릭 선교원(St. Eadric's Mission)에 있는 성 이드릭(St. Eadric)의 무덤에서 관 덮개.
site_reviews.after: 다음 물건을 훔쳐야 한다. 다이덴힐(Didenhil)의 귀족 이얼프위그 그릴리카스(Ealfwig Grilricas)의 메달, 그리고 성 이드릭 선교원(St. Eadric's Mission)에 있는 성 이드릭(St. Eadric)의 무덤에서 관 덮개.
site_reviews.en: You will steal the following: the medallion from the noble, Ealfwig Grilricas in Didenhil, and the burial pall of St. Eadric, from his tomb in St. Eadric's Mission.
site_reviews.ja: これから言うものを盗んできて。ダイデンヒルにいるイールフウィグ・グリルリカスという貴族のメダル。聖イードリック修道院に眠る聖イードリックの骸布
site_reviews.zh: 你要偷到下列物品：迪登希尔贵族埃夫维格·格瑞里加斯的奖章，圣艾德里克布道所里圣艾德里克坟墓中的裹尸布。

site_reviews.before: 성 오드윅 영구 선교회(St. Odwig's Perpetual Mission)의 딘웰 신부(Father Dynwel)는 자신이 돌보는 막내 수도사, 에간 수사(Brother Egan)를 걱정하고 있다. 그는 선교회 북쪽 숲으로 사라졌다. 숲을 수색해 그가 어떻게 됐는지 알아봐야 한다.
site_reviews.after: 성 오드윅 영구 선교원(St. Odwig's Perpetual Mission)의 딘웰 신부(Father Dynwel)는 자신이 돌보는 막내 수도사, 에간 수사(Brother Egan)를 걱정하고 있다. 그는 선교원 북쪽 숲으로 사라졌다. 숲을 수색해 그가 어떻게 됐는지 알아봐야 한다.
site_reviews.en: Father Dynwel of St. Odwig's Perpetual Mission is worried about his youngest monk in his care, Brother Egan. The monk disappeared into the woods north of the mission. I should explore the forest for this lost soul and learn what became of him.
site_reviews.ja: 聖オドウィグ終身修道院のディンウェル神父が、一番若い修道士のブラザー・イーガンを心配している。修道院の北の森で行方不明になったという。森を捜索して、悩める魂の消息を突き止めよう。
site_reviews.zh: 圣奥德威格永恒布道所的丁维尔神父为他手下最年轻的僧侣，伊根修士，感到担忧。这名僧侣在修道院北边的树林中消失了。我应该搜索那片森林，了解他到底发生了什么。

site_reviews.before: 그 신부님이 아니었다면 난 선교회에서 설 자리가 없었을 거야. 미사루(Mitharu)께서 우리를 위해, 나를 위해, 더 큰 계획을 품고 계시다고 믿으셨지.
site_reviews.after: 그 신부님이 아니었다면 난 선교원에서 설 자리가 없었을 거야. 미사루(Mitharu)께서 우리를 위해, 나를 위해, 더 큰 계획을 품고 계시다고 믿으셨지.
site_reviews.en: Without the father I would not have a place at the mission. He took it on faith that Mitharu has a larger plan for us. For me.
site_reviews.ja: 神官ディンウェルがいなければ、この修道院にいる意義を見出せなくなるわ。ミサールへの信仰心よりも大きな愛で、私たちを包んでくれるの
site_reviews.zh: 没有神父，布道所根本就没有我的一席之地。他深深地相信米萨鲁将降大任于我们。于我。

site_reviews.before: 패란즈(Faelands)에는 이제 막 왔어. 선교단에 들어오기 전엔 고향 마을 밖으로 나가 본 적도 없었지. 그래서 자원했어. 세상을 보고 싶었거든.
site_reviews.after: 패란즈(Faelands)에는 이제 막 왔어. 선교원에 들어오기 전엔 고향 마을 밖으로 나가 본 적도 없었지. 그래서 자원했어. 세상을 보고 싶었거든.
site_reviews.en: I am new to the Faelands. Until I joined the mission, I'd never even left my home village. That's why I volunteered, I wanted to see the world.
site_reviews.ja: フェイランドは初めてなんだ。修道院に入るまでは、故郷の村を離れたことは一度もなかった。だから志願したんだ。世界を知りたかったんだよ
site_reviews.zh: 我刚来灵族大陆。加入了布道所之前，我从未离开过家乡。我之所以志愿加入，就是想见见世面。

site_reviews.before: 글렌다라 숲(Glendara Wood) 북쪽에 성 하드윈(St. Hadwyn) 선교원이 있어. 그곳의 수도사들은 다들 좋은 사람들이야.
site_reviews.after: 글렌다라 숲(Glendara Wood) 북쪽에 성 하드윈(St. Hadwyn) 선교원이 있어. 그곳의 수도사들은 다들 좋은 사람들이야.
site_reviews.en: St. Hadwyn's is due north in Glendara Wood. Good folk there, the brothers.
site_reviews.ja: グレンダーラの森を北に進むと、聖ハドウィン修道院があるの。気のいい修道士たちばかりよ
site_reviews.zh: 圣哈德温的布道团位于格伦达拉森林正北。那里的修士们都是好人。

site_reviews.before: 에테어 신부(Father Etair)와 울프 수사(Brother Wulf)는 성 이드릭 선교원(St. Eadric's Mission) 우물을 발굴하다가 기이한 수정 몇 개를 발견했다. 그 수정들이 사라진 모양이다. 우물부터 찾아봐야겠다. 에테어(Etair)는 살해당하기 직전 물을 길으러 가는 모습이 목격됐다.
site_reviews.after: 에테어 신부(Father Etair)와 울프 수사(Brother Wulf)는 성 이드릭 선교원(St. Eadric's Mission) 우물을 발굴하다가 기이한 수정 몇 개를 발견했다. 그 수정들이 사라진 모양이다. 우물부터 찾아봐야겠다. 에테어(Etair)는 살해당하기 직전 물을 길으러 가는 모습이 목격됐다.
site_reviews.en: Father Etair and Brother Wulf discovered some strange crystals during an excavation in the St. Eadric's Mission well. They seem to have disappeared. I should search the well first. Etair was seen fetching water just before his murder.
site_reviews.ja: 神官エタイアとブラザー・ウルフが聖イードリック修道院の井戸の掘削中に見つけたという、不思議なクリスタルが消えてしまった。まず泉を探そう。神官エタイアは死の直前に水を汲みに行った所を目撃されている。
site_reviews.zh: 埃泰尔神父和伍尔夫修士在圣艾德里克布道所的水井进行开采时，发现了一些奇怪的水晶。这些水晶似乎不见了。我应该先去调查那口水井。埃泰尔被杀之前，有人看到他在打水。

site_reviews.before: 서머스 엔드(Summer's End)의 야생 페이(Wild Fae)들은 시녀(The Maid)의 마법으로 온순해져 있다. 그 힘은 성 이드릭(St. Eadric) 선교회의 수도사들을 미치게 한 바로 그 정체불명의 수정에서 나온다. 울프 수사(Brother Wulf)의 피리를 불면 수정을 찾아 파괴할 수 있을지도 모른다.
site_reviews.after: 서머스 엔드(Summer's End)의 야생 페이(Wild Fae)들은 시녀(The Maid)의 마법으로 온순해져 있다. 그 힘은 성 이드릭(St. Eadric) 선교원의 수도사들을 미치게 한 바로 그 정체불명의 수정에서 나온다. 울프 수사(Brother Wulf)의 피리를 불면 수정을 찾아 파괴할 수 있을지도 모른다.
site_reviews.en: The wild Fae in Summer's End are kept pacified by the Maid's enchantments, which are powered by the same mysterious crystal that drove the monks at St. Eadric's to madness. Perhaps if I use Brother Wulf's whistle I can find and destroy them.
site_reviews.ja: サマーズ・エンドの野生のフェイは、"ウィンダメアの烈女"の魔法により静められている。使われているのは、聖イードリックの修道士の正気を失わせた物と同じ、謎のクリスタルだ。ブラザー・ウルフの笛を使えば、破壊できるかも知れない。
site_reviews.zh: 这位住在夏之终焉的荒野灵族在少女的魔法下非常平静，并获得了使圣艾德里克的僧侣变得疯狂的神秘水晶的强化。或许，如果我使用伍尔夫修士的长笛，就能找到并摧毁这些水晶。

site_reviews.before: 그리고 당신은... 부탁한 일을 해 줬고, 성 오드윅(St. Odwig) 수도원 모두가 영원히 감사하고 있어. 이 보잘것없는 보상은 네 대의에 보태는 기부금으로 여겨 줘. 물론, 하나뿐이지만.
site_reviews.after: 그리고 당신은... 부탁한 일을 해 줬고, 성 오드윅(St. Odwig) 선교원 모두가 영원히 감사하고 있어. 이 보잘것없는 보상은 네 대의에 보태는 기부금으로 여겨 줘. 물론, 하나뿐이지만.
site_reviews.en: As for you... you have done as I asked, and we here at St. Odwig's are forever grateful. Consider this meager reward a donation to your cause. It is just one, to be sure.
site_reviews.ja: 君は... 要望に応えてくれた。聖オドウィグ修道院は永遠に感謝する。わずかな報酬だが君の目標への寄付と思ってくれ。わずかなものだが
site_reviews.zh: 至于你……你已经按照我的要求做了，我们永远在圣奥德威格心存感激。把这微薄的报酬看作是对你事业的捐赠吧。当然，这只是一个。

site_reviews.before: 이 열쇠는 성 오드윅 선교원(St. Odwig's Mission)의 델프 수사(Brother Delf) 소유다. 그가 레드 리전(Red Legion)에서 지내며 훔친 귀중품이 든 상자를 여는 열쇠일 것이다.
site_reviews.after: 이 열쇠는 성 오드윅 선교원(St. Odwig's Mission)의 델프 수사(Brother Delf) 소유다. 그가 레드 리전(Red Legion)에서 지내며 훔친 귀중품이 든 상자를 여는 열쇠일 것이다.
site_reviews.en: This key belongs to Brother Delf of St. Odwig's Mission, and it likely opens a chest containing the valuables he stole during his time with the Red Legion.
site_reviews.ja: この鍵は聖オドウィグ修道院のブラザー・デルフのもの。レッドリージョン団時代に彼が盗んだものを入れた箱を開くものと思われる。
site_reviews.zh: 这把钥匙属于圣奥德威格布道所的德尔夫修士，它可能会打开一个箱子，里面装着他在雷德帮时偷来的贵重物品。

site_reviews.before: 선교원 사람들과 함께 사는 게 만족스러워? 그들은 널 깔보고 무시해! 네 무지를 비웃는다고!
site_reviews.after: 선교원 사람들과 함께 사는 게 만족스러워? 그들은 널 깔보고 무시해! 네 무지를 비웃는다고!
site_reviews.en: Are you content to live among the lives of the Mission? They look down their eyes at you! They laugh at your ignorance!
site_reviews.ja: 修道院での生活に満足している？ ヤツらに見下されているのよ！ あなたの無知を笑っているのよ！
site_reviews.zh: 你满足于活在布道所的生命之间吗？他们瞧不起你！他们嘲笑你的无知！

site_reviews.before: 틸 수사(Brother Til)의 분실된 책을 전부 회수했다. 오다라스(Odarath)의 성 오드윅 영구 선교회(St. Odwig's Perpetual Mission)로 가서 경전 도서관에 돌려줘야겠다.
site_reviews.after: 틸 수사(Brother Til)의 분실된 책을 전부 회수했다. 오다라스(Odarath)의 성 오드윅 영구 선교원(St. Odwig's Perpetual Mission)으로 가서 경전 도서관에 돌려줘야겠다.
site_reviews.en: I've recovered all of Brother's Til's missing books. I should travel to St. Odwig's Perpetual Mission in Odarath and return them to the scripture library.
site_reviews.ja: ブラザー・ティルの行方不明の本を回収した。オダラスの聖オドウィグ終身修道院へ行き、聖書図書館に返却しよう。
site_reviews.zh: 我已经取回了蒂尔修士丢失的每一本藏书。我应该前往欧达拉斯的圣奥德威格永恒布道所，将它们放回图书馆。

site_reviews.before: 나그네여, 네 덕분에 우리 선교회가 다시 온전해졌다. 에간 수사(Brother Egan)를 데려와 준 은혜는 결코 다 갚을 수 없을 것이다.
site_reviews.after: 나그네여, 네 덕분에 우리 선교원이 다시 온전해졌다. 에간 수사(Brother Egan)를 데려와 준 은혜는 결코 다 갚을 수 없을 것이다.
site_reviews.en: You have made our mission whole again, stranger. We cannot ever truly repay you for bringing back Brother Egan.
site_reviews.ja: 我らの修道院を再び完全にしてくれたな、旅人よ。ブラザー・イーガンを帰してくれたことは、返し切れない借りとなった
site_reviews.zh: 陌生人，你又使我们的布道所完整了。你把伊根修士带回来了，这份大恩大德我们无以为报。

site_reviews.before: 성 이드릭(St. Eadric)과 성 오드윅(St. Odwig)의 성소, 그리고 바로 이 선교원 앞에서 기도해. 기도할 때마다 염주가 더 강해질 거야.
site_reviews.after: 성 이드릭(St. Eadric)과 성 오드윅(St. Odwig)의 성소, 그리고 바로 이 선교원 앞에서 기도해. 기도할 때마다 염주가 더 강해질 거야.
site_reviews.en: Pray at the shrines of St. Eadric's, St. Odwig's, and before this very Mission. At each one you pray, the beads will be improved.
site_reviews.ja: 聖イードリックと聖オドウィグの聖堂、そしてこの修道院で祈るといい。祈る度に、ビーズは高まる
site_reviews.zh: 在圣埃得里克、圣奥德威格的神龛中，以及在这个布道所之前祈祷。你每祈祷一次，串珠就会得到增强。

site_reviews.before: 이곳 사람들은 친절하지만 의심이 많아. 선교원(Mission)에 비밀이 있다고 믿는데, 그 말이 맞아.
site_reviews.after: 이곳 사람들은 친절하지만 의심이 많아. 선교원(Mission)에 비밀이 있다고 믿는데, 그 말이 맞아.
site_reviews.en: The people here are kind, yet suspicious. They believe the mission harbors secrets and they're right.
site_reviews.ja: 住人は親切だが、疑り深いところがある。修道院が何か秘密を隠していると思ってるんだ
site_reviews.zh: 这里的人都很好心，然而也很多疑。他们认为布道所藏着秘密，而他们是对的。

site_reviews.before: 성 하드윈 선교회(St. Hadwyn's Mission)는 글렌다라(Glendara)를 지나 북쪽에 있어.
site_reviews.after: 성 하드윈 선교원(St. Hadwyn's Mission)은 글렌다라(Glendara)를 지나 북쪽에 있어.
site_reviews.en: St. Hadwyn's is north of here, through Glendara.
site_reviews.ja: 聖ハドウィン修道院はグレンダーラを抜けた北にあります
site_reviews.zh: 圣哈德温布道所就在北边，穿过格伦达拉就到了。

site_reviews.before: 여행 중에 성 오드윅의 영구 선교회(St. Odwig's Perpetual Mission)에서 경전 책임자를 맡았던 고 틸 수사(Brother Til)의 책을 발견했다. 제목만 봐도 틸(Til)의 문학적 취향이 외설적이고 음탕한 쪽이었던 듯하다. 사라진 책을 모두 찾아 틸(Til)의 장서에 돌려주면 보상을 받을 수 있다.
site_reviews.after: 여행 중에 성 오드윅 영구 선교원(St. Odwig's Perpetual Mission)에서 경전 책임자를 맡았던 고 틸 수사(Brother Til)의 책을 발견했다. 제목만 봐도 틸(Til)의 문학적 취향이 외설적이고 음탕한 쪽이었던 듯하다. 사라진 책을 모두 찾아 틸(Til)의 장서에 돌려주면 보상을 받을 수 있다.
site_reviews.en: During your travels you have come upon a book belonging to Brother Til, the late Scripture Master of St. Odwig's Perpetual Mission. From the looks of the titles, Til's literary interests tended toward the lewd and lascivious. Retrieve all of the missing volumes and you return them to Til's Collection for a reward.
site_reviews.ja: 旅の途中で、聖オドウィグ終身修道院で経典長を務めていた、今は亡きブラザー・ティルのものであった書物を発見した。見出しから判断するに、ティルの文学的興味はわいせつでみだらな方面に傾倒していたようだ。なくなっている本を全て集めてティルの蔵書に戻せば報酬が得られるだろう。
site_reviews.zh: 在你的旅行中，你发现了一本属于提尔修士的书，他是圣奥德威格的永恒布道所的已故经文大师。从标题上看，提尔的文学兴趣似乎倾向于淫荡和好色。找回所有丢失的卷，并将它们送还到提尔的收藏中以获得奖励。

site_reviews.before: 에테어 신부(Father Etair)는 살해당했다. 선교원에 있는 수사 한 명과 이야기해 지도자에게 무슨 일이 있었는지, 그가 죽기 전에 하던 일을 알아낼 방법이 있는지 확인해야겠다.
site_reviews.after: 에테어 신부(Father Etair)는 살해당했다. 선교원에 있는 수사 한 명과 이야기해 지도자에게 무슨 일이 있었는지, 그가 죽기 전에 하던 일을 알아낼 방법이 있는지 확인해야겠다.
site_reviews.en: Father Etair is dead, murdered. I should speak to one of the monks at the mission to find out what happened to their leader, and if there is any way I can learn what he'd been doing when he died.
site_reviews.ja: エタイア神父は殺されていた。修道院の修道士と話し、指導者に何が起きたのか、死ぬ時に何をしていたのか分かる手段があるか尋ねよう。
site_reviews.zh: 埃泰尔神父已经死了，被人谋杀。我应该与布道所中的僧侣谈谈，获得相关的情报，看看是否能够知晓他死前都在做些什么。

site_reviews.after: 성 하드윈 선교원(St. Hadwyn's Mission)
